PUBLIC INFORMATION

The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council
during the designated public comment periods. There will be two Oral
Communication sessions: one for Agendized Items (comment about items ON the

3 minutes depending on the number of speakers.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC) Mayor Davis-Holmes would like staff to bring recommendations on how the city can assist with the crisis in Maui.

COUNCIL MEMBER REQUESTS TO ADD ITEMS TO FUTURE AGENDAS MPT Hilton invites the public to Fam Fest on August 26th.
Councilman Dear expressed his excitement about Tour de Carson and thanked staff for their hard work on the event. Dear said it was a healthy even that should be considered annually. 
Councilwoman Rojas expressed her desire for that event to be annual along with the street fair. 
Mayor Davis-Holmes thanks Councilman Hicks for running lead on most of the anniversary events. She said it is time for staff to begin looking at events that can be consolidated and events that bring 200 people are no longer special events. Kudos to the staff on a stellar job well done! To the volunteers and Watson Land who helped with the backpack giveaway. The staff is to be commended on several back to back events. 
Councilman Hicks "ditto" to all that has been shared already. The Tour de Carson was a fun ride. 
Mayor Davis-Holmes would also like an update on the SMP for travel and travel reimbursement.
